result.description: Standard change to deploy the payment tokenization service (PAY-101) to the mfs-prod OpenShift namespace. Deploys updated container images to mfs-pay-pod-01 and mfs-pay-pod-02. Service uses svc-payment-api and svc-token-vault service accounts. Database migrations applied to mfs_payments_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal for card_tokens and token_audit_log tables.
result.implementation_plan:
1. Deploy updated mfs-payment-gateway image to mfs-staging namespace
2. Run smoke tests in staging
3. Apply database migration to mfs_payments_db
4. Rolling update to mfs-pay-pod-01, mfs-pay-pod-02 in mfs-prod
5. Verify health checks and token generation
6. Monitor error rates for 30 minutes
result.backout_plan:
1. Revert to previous container image tag
2. Rollback database migration
3. Verify service health
result.test_plan: Execute TC-PAY-001 and TC-PAY-002 in staging before prod deployment
result.close_notes: Tokenization service deployed successfully. All health checks passed. TC-PAY-001 and TC-PAY-002 passed in production.

result.short_description: Enable data-at-rest encryption for cardholder data
result.description: Normal change to enable AES-256-GCM encryption for cardholder data at rest in mfs_payments_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal. This is a PCI DSS v4.0 compliance requirement (Req 3.4, 3.5). Requires CAB approval due to database-level changes affecting the cardholder_data table. Uses svc-token-vault service account for HSM key retrieval via mfs-vault-pod-01.
result.implementation_plan:
1. Backup mfs_payments_db cardholder_data table
2. Enable pgcrypto extension on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal
3. Apply column-level encryption migration
4. Deploy updated mfs-token-vault with encryption support to mfs-vault-pod-01
5. Verify encryption via TC-PAY-005
6. Enable TDE for mfs_payments_db tablespace
7. Validate HSM key retrieval via svc-token-vault
8. Monitor decryption latency for 1 hour
result.backout_plan:
1. Restore cardholder_data from backup
2. Revert mfs-token-vault to previous version
3. Disable pgcrypto extension if no other dependencies
result.test_plan: Execute TC-PAY-005 post-deployment. Verify decryption latency < 10ms.
result.close_notes: Encryption at rest enabled successfully. All cardholder data now encrypted with AES-256-GCM. TC-PAY-005 passed. Decryption latency measured at 4ms p99.

result.description: P2 incident: Significant increase in payment processing timeouts observed on mfs-pay-pod-01 in mfs-prod namespace. Payment API response times spiked from 200ms p99 to 2500ms p99 at 2026-09-28 14:30 UTC. Approximately 15% of payment requests timing out at the 5-second gateway timeout threshold. Affected service: mfs-payment-gateway running under svc-payment-api service account. Initial investigation shows high connection wait times to mfs_payments_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal.
result.resolution_notes: Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion on mfs-pay-pod-01 due to long-running tokenization queries after CHG0090101 deployment. Resolution: Increased connection pool max size from 20 to 50 and added query timeout of 3 seconds. Applied connection pool tuning to mfs-pay-pod-02 and mfs-pay-pod-03 preventatively.

result.description: P3 incident: Token vault service showing intermittent latency degradation on mfs-vault-pod-01 in mfs-prod namespace. Token retrieval operations via svc-token-vault service account experiencing 500ms+ response times (normal: < 50ms). HSM key retrieval appears to be the bottleneck. No data loss or security impact identified. Approximately 5% of token retrieval requests affected.
result.work_notes:
2026-09-30 10:00 - Investigating HSM connection pool configuration on mfs-vault-pod-01. Suspected cause: HSM session reuse not properly configured after CHG0090201 encryption enablement.
2026-09-30 14:00 - Confirmed HSM PKCS#11 session pool was set to 5 concurrent sessions. Increasing to 20 for testing.
